metadata.title: Palantir Partnership Gets Positive Needham View

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir (NASDAQ:PLTR) is getting a fresh analyst nod after Needham called its 7-year partnership with Zeta Global strategically positive, even as shares of both companies slipped on Wednesday, according to Seeking Alpha.
The deal will combine Palantir's Foundry platform with Zeta's Data Cloud and Athena, Zeta's AI agent for enterprise marketing teams.
In Needham's view, the partnership matters because Foundry will become the data operating layer beneath Athena, potentially improving the performance of Zeta's marketing infrastructure while giving Palantir another enterprise use case for its data and AI platform.
Needham analysts led by Scott Berg said the agreement does not materially change Zeta's near-term financial outlook, with management noting no impact on FY26 guidance and limited impact on operating expenses. But the firm said the go-to-market agreement includes performance incentives for Palantir, which could create another growth vector tied to Zeta's longer-term FY28 targets.
For investors, it's imperative to note that Palantir is continuing to push Foundry deeper into commercial AI workflows. Needham kept a Buy rating and $25 target on Zeta, while PLTR and ZETA each fell about 3%.
